changed_factor: the periodically switching complete parameter and process-scale truth schedule
fixed_factors: matched forcing and random draws, 45 assimilation days, full interaction and one-, three-, seven-day leads
hypothesis: the complete joint method retains identification and forecast value when complete parameter and process-scale labels switch periodically
notes: This is a bounded rapid-switch stress condition: both complete parameter and process-scale labels change every seven days, while the filter keeps a factor-level stay probability of 0.98. At the forecast origin the current label has three assimilated observations, and the next truth switch occurs at lead day five, between the evaluated three- and seven-day targets. It does not establish behavior for other switch periods, matched transition priors, weak observations, forcing error or real basins. The covariance controls only pre-projection scale; post-projection truth is not an exact additive Gaussian candidate model.
